title: account_payment_interco — intercompany journal deep L3 (GAP-002 extension)
gap_summary: Module provides automatic two-way journal entry creation and reconciliation on invoice post via provider-based payment flow only; no reversal propagation; no manual-payment coverage; config must be set on both companies

layer_applicability.L1: APPLICABLE — LGPL-3 Community module, depends on account_payment only
layer_applicability.L2: APPLICABLE — 3 company config fields, settings relay, 2 new methods + 1 override
layer_applicability.L3: APPLICABLE — trigger on invoice _post, two-phase journal creation, automatic reconciliation
layer_applicability.L4: APPLICABLE — sudo + with_company cross-company ORM calls, _seek_for_lines dependency
layer_applicability.L5: APPLICABLE — settings view only, gated on multi-company group
layer_applicability.L6: APPLICABLE — sudo used, with_company used, no dedicated ir.rule in module
layer_applicability.L7: APPLICABLE — 3 per-company accounts + clearing journal required on both companies
layer_applicability.L8: NOT APPLICABLE — no reversal logic in module, gap identified
layer_applicability.L9: APPLICABLE — two-entry double-sided posting pattern documented
layer_applicability.L10: NOT APPLICABLE — synchronous only, no cron/queue
layer_applicability.L11: NOT APPLICABLE — no controllers or API endpoints
layer_applicability.L12: APPLICABLE — AWT tests defined in test file

key_findings: Trigger is invoice _post (not payment post) — workflow fires when invoice is confirmed with a cross-company payment already linked
Two journal entries are created: (1) clearing entry in PAYMENT company against interco payable/receivable, (2) settlement entry in INVOICE company against interco receivable/payable
Both legs are automatically reconciled against the original AR/AP and payment outstanding lines
Only transaction-based (provider) payments are covered — manual payments are excluded
No reversal propagation — this is a gap for MCT-F02
sudo() + with_company() pattern used throughout — no dedicated ir.rule
Multi-currency: payment currency used for clearing leg, company currency for settlement leg
Silent fail if config missing — no error raised, no warning
awt_evidence_needed: Search posted journal entry in payment company with memo reference
Search posted journal entry in invoice company with Interco Settlement prefix
Confirm payment outstanding lines reconciled = True
